title: Decimals
summary: Place value, rounding, adding, subtracting, multiplying and dividing decimals, and connecting decimals, fractions and percentages.

cards.title: Place value and decimals
cards.rule: After the point: tenths, hundredths, thousandths.

cards.title: Rounding decimals
cards.rule: Look at the next digit: 5 or more rounds up.

cards.title: Adding and subtracting
cards.rule: Line up the decimal points. Fill gaps with zeros.

cards.title: × and ÷ by 10, 100, 1000
cards.rule: Multiply: digits move left. Divide: digits move right. One place for each zero.

cards.title: Multiplying decimals
cards.rule: Multiply as whole numbers, then count the decimal places.

cards.title: Dividing decimals
cards.rule: Make the number you're dividing by whole: move both points the same way.

cards.title: Decimals and fractions
cards.rule: To turn a fraction into a decimal, divide the top by the bottom.

cards.title: Decimals and percentages
cards.rule: Decimal to percentage: multiply by 100. Percentage to decimal: divide by 100.

cards.title: Expressing proportions
cards.rule: Write the part over the whole, then convert.
